integrity: Proof and fully runnable finite tests supplied. Literature comparison is best-knowledge and is not an exhaustive novelty certificate. No independent scholarly validation.
scientific_limitations: Linear binary words only, fixed weight, adjacent swaps, bounds r,s>=2 not simultaneously two; nonempty state space. Cyclic words, larger alphabets, weighted moves and arbitrary forbidden words are outside scope; finite computation does not prove the all-parameter theorem. Residual risk of equivalent bounded-gap lattice formulations in literature.
title: Median swap graphs for binary words with bounded monochromatic runs
